mapper.select: SELECT /*LGVATT20441.retrieveMutiplanDetail*/ a.planning_id as planning_id ,a.approval_request_id as approval_request_id ,a.subsidiary_code as subsidiary_code ,a.employee_no as employee_no ,e.full_name_local || '(' || e.user_name || ')' || '/' || NVL(e.position_name,e.title_name) || '/' || e.organization_name_eng AS requestor ,( select lcc.common_code_desc as name from lgcom_common_code_c lcc, tb_att_code_c cac where lcc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_TYPE_CODE' and lcc.common_code = cac.time_and_attendance_type_code and cac.time_and_attendance_code = a.time_and_attendance_code ) AS attendance_type ,(select tac.time_and_attendance_name from tb_att_code_c tac where tac.time_and_attendance_code = a.time_and_attendance_code) AS attendance_type_detail ,(select lcc.common_code_desc from lgcom_common_code_c lcc where lcc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_CODE' and lcc.common_code = a.time_attend_detail_code) as detail_reason ,a.time_and_attendance_code as time_and_attendance_code ,TO_CHAR(a.plan_start_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') as plan_start_date ,TO_CHAR(a.plan_end_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') as plan_end_date ,a.request_reason_content as request_reason_content ,a.approval_request_id as approval_request_id ,a.creation_user_id as creation_user_id ,TO_CHAR(a.creation_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') as creation_date ,a.last_update_user_id as last_update_user_id ,TO_CHAR(a.last_update_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') as last_update_date ,TO_CHAR(a.creation_date,'dd/mm/yyyy') as request_date FROM TB_ATT_LT_TIME_ATTEND_PLAN_N a LEFT OUTER JOIN lgcom_approval_request_n b ON a.approval_request_id = b.request_master_id LEFT OUTER JOIN lgcom_user_m_v e ON a.employee_no = e.user_name WHERE a.approval_request_id = #{approvalRequestId} AND a.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}
